svg.title: Multi-writer commit p99 latency
svg.desc: Line charts, one per backend: commit p99 latency against the number of concurrent writers (2, 4, 8 and 16) for moraine, Lance and Delta Lake.
svg.text: commit p99 in ms, median, log scale; lower is better
